in_marathi.name: Samidha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Intelligent, Graceful, Brave
in_marathi.long_meaning: Samidha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Samidha means intelligent, graceful, and brave. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'samidh' which means 'kept in mind' or 'to be remembered'. This name signifies a strong and intelligent woman who is remembered for her wisdom and courage.
